product_name: 大型体育赛事安全防护
summary: 针对万人以上集结的赛事、展览会，解决人员密集、流控复杂、低空安全盲区等痛点。融合反无预警与智能安检终端，实现场馆全天候全域监测，并高效拦截危禁品，守护赛事有序安全举办。
summary_en: Targeted at events and exhibitions with over 10,000 people, addressing pain points such as high personnel density, complex flow control, and low-altitude security blind spots. It integrates anti-UAV early warning with intelligent security terminals to achieve 24/7 panoramic monitoring of venues and efficiently intercept dangerous goods, ensuring the orderly and safe holding of events.
key_application: Event / Exhibition Security Guarantee (赛事/大型展会保障)
key_parameter_1: 高并发智能查验: 解决千万级人群集聚下的高效安检与危禁品快速拦截
key_parameter_1_en: High-concurrency Screening: Efficient security and rapid contraband interception for large crowds
key_parameter_2: 无死角低空监测: 融合全向探测与视频追踪，实时防范“黑飞”无人机风险
key_parameter_2_en: Omni-directional Monitoring: Integrated radar and video tracking to prevent illegal drone risks

parameters.设备机动性: 便携式单兵或车载部署
parameters.监测范围: 场馆核心区及周边 360° 无死角
parameters.数据同步: 现场指挥中心 5G 实时视频

detail_html:
赛事保障详解

面对千万级人群集聚的现场，方案强调快速部署与高压拦截能力。利用便携式反制设备建立临时禁飞区，配合快速安检门，实现平稳有序的流控与防卫。

  • 融合监控、反无、安检三大核心板块
  • 高效拦截打火机、火药、毒品等危禁品
  • 场馆全域全天候监测
detail_html_en:
Event Protection Details

Facing massive crowds, the solution emphasizes rapid deployment and high-pressure interception capabilities. Temporary no-fly zones are established using portable devices, complemented by rapid screening gates for orderly flow control and defense.

  • Integrates monitoring, anti-UAV, and security screening
  • Efficiently intercepts lighters, gunpowder, drugs, etc.
  • Panoramic 24/7 venue monitoring
